items.title: Proto-Elamite Writing in Iran
items.note: Survey of the corpus and its sites setting out Desset's case for continuity between Proto-Elamite and later Iranian writing.

items.title: The Proto-Elamite Writing System
items.note: Handbook overview of the script's numerical systems, sign repertoire and administrative function.

items.title: Linear Elamite Writing
items.note: Companion overview of the later Linear Elamite corpus, laying out the comparison with Proto-Elamite signs.

items.title: A New Proto-Elamite Seal Impression from Tappeh Sofalin, Central Iranian Plateau
items.note: Publishes a sealing from Tappeh Sofalin, one of the plateau sites that has also yielded Proto-Elamite tablets outside Susa.

items.title: Nine Linear Elamite Texts Inscribed on Silver 'Gunagi' Vessels (X, Y, Z, F', H', I', J', K' and L'): New Data on Linear Elamite Writing and the History of the Sukkalmaḫ Dynasty
items.note: Adds nine inscribed silver vessels to the small Linear Elamite corpus, part of the material behind the 2022 decipherment claim.

items.title: Tablettes et fragments proto-élamites / Proto-Elamite Tablets and Fragments (TCL 32)
items.note: Edits 121 previously unpublished Louvre tablets and fragments from Susa, enlarging the corpus available for structural analysis.

items.title: pe-decipher-toolkit
items.who: Simon Fraser University Natural Language Lab
items.note: Python notebooks for basic NLP analysis over the CDLI Proto-Elamite transliterations, released with the group's computational studies.

items.title: Sign Clustering and Topic Extraction in Proto-Elamite
items.who: L. Born, K. Kelley, N. Kambhatla, C. Chen and A. Sarkar
items.note: Clustering, n-gram and topic models replicate manual sign groupings and suggest new relationships between signs.

items.title: Application of Scanning Electron and Atomic Force Mode Microscopy on inscription from Proto-Elamite period in Tappeh Sofalin
items.note: Microscopic imaging of an inscribed Sofalin tablet to study stylus impressions and the physical making of signs.

items.title: Compositionality of Complex Graphemes in the Undeciphered Proto-Elamite Script using Image and Text Embedding Models
items.who: L. Born, K. Kelley, M. W. Monroe and A. Sarkar
items.note: Tests whether complex signs behave as combinations of their components using image and distributional embeddings; code released on GitHub.

items.title: Iran's first state? The Proto-Elamite horizon, 3200–2900 BC
items.who: R. Matthews and H. Fazeli Nashli
items.venue: The Archaeology of Iran from the Palaeolithic to the Achaemenid Empire (Routledge)
items.note: Archaeological synthesis of the Proto-Elamite horizon across Iran, framing the tablets within settlement and administrative networks.

items.title: The Decipherment of Linear Elamite Writing
items.who: F. Desset, K. Tabibzadeh, M. Kervran, G. P. Basello and G. Marchesi
items.note: Proposes phonetic values for Linear Elamite from royal names on silver vessels and argues the script descends from Proto-Elamite.

items.title: pe-sign-value-data
items.who: Simon Fraser University Natural Language Lab
items.note: Proto-Elamite corpus with hypothetical sound values inserted, a test bed for checking proposed phonetic readings against the texts.

items.title: Sequence Models for Document Structure Identification in an Undeciphered Script
items.who: L. Born, M. Monroe, K. Kelley and A. Sarkar
items.note: Unsupervised sequence models give independent evidence for the 'header' signs that experts identified at the start of Proto-Elamite accounts.

items.title: Disambiguating Numeral Sequences to Decipher Ancient Accounting Corpora
items.who: L. Born, M. W. Monroe, K. Kelley and A. Sarkar
items.venue: Workshop on Computation and Written Language (CAWL 2023)
items.note: Models the ambiguous numerical notations of Proto-Elamite accounts to infer which counting system each sequence uses.

items.title: proto-elamite_data
items.note: CDLI release of Proto-Elamite transliteration data in machine-readable form for computational work.

items.title: Proto-Elamite and Linear Elamite, a Misunderstood Relationship?
items.note: Argues that resemblances across more than 500 years reflect late third-millennium borrowing rather than direct descent.

items.title: Applications of Natural Language Processing to Archaeological Decipherment: A Survey of Proto-Elamite
items.note: Gathers the group's computational work on signs, headers and numerals into a survey of what NLP can and cannot establish about the script.

items.title: New insights into the chronology of six Linear Elamite clay artifacts from Susa: A re-examination of Roland de Mecquenem's archaeological reports
items.note: Re-dates Linear Elamite objects from old Susa excavations, bearing on the chronological gap between the two scripts.

items.title: Some new Linear Elamite inscriptions
items.venue: BAF-Online: Proceedings of the Berner Altorientalisches Forum
items.note: Publishes about ten Linear Elamite inscriptions and fragments first presented at Hamburg in 2016.

items.title: Recent Progress in Deciphering Proto-Elamite
items.who: M. W. Monroe, K. Kelley, L. Born and A. Sarkar
items.note: Reports results of the combined mathematical, computational and philological approach to the script's structure.

items.title: Proto-Elamite
items.note: Synthesis describing about 1,700 tablets dated c. 3300–2900 BCE and the current state of interdisciplinary decipherment.
